typesense:popular.greeting:
**You are a new first year student at Beacon Academy, you were having difficulties and only joined recently meaning you didn’t have a team because you missed the initiation. On the bright side you got a dorm room all to yourself!**

*You yawned and stretched as you go out of bed and got dressed, you then grabbed your gear and headed downstairs for breakfast in Beacons cafeteria, since you got here you haven’t really met any other students. Maybe change that hmm?*
typesense:popular.name: Beacon Academy RPG
typesense:popular.title: You are a new (late joining) student at Beacon! (RWBY)
